{{Quote|Guerilla raids are one thing, but our forces aren't trained or equipped to fight Special Operations commandos. If we lose, we lose more than the G-Tap, we lose Sulon herself.|[[Morgan Katarn]] before the [[Battle of the G-Tap]]|<ref name="Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref>}}
'''Imperial Special Operations''',<ref name="DFmanual">''[[Dark Forces Manual: Coded Transmissions]]''</ref> or '''Imperial Spec Ops''',<ref name="SWG:C3">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Chapter 3: Smugglers and Scoundrels}}</ref>  was a unit of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a division of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="DFmanual">''[[Dark Forces Manual: Coded Transmissions]]''</ref>

The [[Ghost Battalion]], officially the Special Ops Group, was a legendary military group of convert operations. In some of their assignments, such as the [[Subjugation of Sulon]], they used converted captured vehicles, or appropriately disguised Imperial vehicles and S.O. [[Imperial_commando/Legends|commandoes]]. The result would be to accuse the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and accuse them for the [[Battle of the G-Tap|massacre]] as terrorists.<ref name="SE">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref>

Around the time of his graduation from the [[Carida Academy]], [[Kyle Katarn]] accepted a commission in the special operations division.<ref name="DFmanual" /> [[Meck Odom]] had requested for a Special Operations assignment. It was granted quickly and he was transferred to the [[Danuta research facility]] where the [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] for the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] was being researched.<ref name="SE" />

A particularly resistant model of [[Imperial Spec Ops Officer armor|battle armor]] was developed for Imperial Spec Ops officers during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:C3" />

{{Rep-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Special Operations is an entity that was intended to appear in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]'', represented by the [[agent]] [[Ruu San]] who protected the [[Dark Trooper Project]], however these references were cut.<ref name="Game Room">{{GalaxyCite|1|Game Room|Game Room: Revving Up the 'Jedi Engine'}}</ref>
